extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, faculty, and institutional administrators in DOE EPSCoR-designated states/territories preparing or considering DOE EPSCoR funding proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the goals and priorities that proposals and activities should address to be competitive for DOE EPSCoR support, emphasizing capacity building, collaboration with national labs, and merit-based selection for early-stage energy-related research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve capability of designated states and territories
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve the capability of designated states and territories to conduct sustainable and nationally competitive energy-related research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a core DOE EPSCoR goal: support early-stage research across DOE program areas to raise the competitiveness and sustainability of research programs in designated jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish foundational research capabilities through human and technical resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish foundational research capabilities in designated states and territories through increased human and technical resources, training scientists and engineers in energy-related areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate how they will build lasting human capital and technical infrastructure (e.g., training programs, staffing, equipment) to create sustained research capability in energy-related fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build relationships with DOE Office of Science national laboratories and leverage user facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Build beneficial relationships between scientists and engineers in the designated states and territories with the 10 world-class laboratories managed by the Office of Science, leverage DOE national user facilities, and take advantage of opportunities for intellectual collaboration across the DOE system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPSCoR emphasizes active collaboration with DOE national labs and use of DOE user facilities; competitive proposals should describe partnerships with labs and plans to leverage unique scientific/technical capabilities and facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadened participation to strengthen the national research network
rubrics_metrics.description: Through broadened participation, DOE EPSCoR seeks to strengthen the network of energy-related research across the nation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities should expand participation in energy-related research geographically and demographically to reinforce national research connectivity and capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science-driven, merit-based support for early-stage research
rubrics_metrics.description: DOE EPSCoR is a science-driven, merit-based program that supports early stage research activities spanning the broad range of science and technology programs within DOE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding decisions are intended to be driven by scientific merit; proposals should present high-quality, scientifically sound early-stage research across DOE program areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority on increasing the number of scientists and engineers in energy-related areas
rubrics_metrics.description: The program places high priority on increasing the number of scientists and engineers in energy-related areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that clearly grow the pipeline of trained researchers (graduate/undergraduate students, postdocs, early-career faculty) in energy-related disciplines are favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on collaboration among young researchers and DOE lab scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: Particular emphasis and importance of collaboration among young faculty, postdoctoral associates, graduate/undergraduate students supported by EPSCoR with scientists from the DOE national laboratories where unique scientific and technical capabilities are present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPSCoR expects meaningful interactions between early-career researchers and lab scientists; proposals should describe collaborative roles, mentoring, and access to lab expertise/ capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support based on merit and peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The program supports the most meritorious proposals based on merit and peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications will be evaluated through a merit-based, peer-review process; proposers should align submissions with standard peer-review expectations (clarity of aims, methodology, impact, and qualifications).
